description: Tier A. Only for repos that satisfy all three preconditions, verified per repo before adoption:
1. a workflow with a `pull_request:` trigger, so Renovate's branch actually produces check runs;
2. that workflow runs a real gate (tests, type-check or build — not just a lint of unrelated files);
3. the gate is currently green on the default branch, so a red PR means the update, not the backlog.
Renovate refuses to automerge unless it sees a passing branch status, and a commit with zero
check runs reports combined state `pending`, which Renovate maps to yellow — so a repo without
PR CI does not silently automerge, it stalls. That is a stuck-branch problem, not a safety net:
this preset is still only applied where CI exists.
ignoreTests stays false. It must never be set in this org.
Scope is deliberately narrow: patch, lockfile, digest, CI actions and dev-only dependencies.
Anything that can reach a user at runtime — a production minor, any major, any 0.x minor, and
every security fix — is left for a human.
platformAutomerge is off on purpose. GitHub only offers its native auto-merge when a PR is not
already mergeable, which means at least one required status check or required review. Private
repos on this account cannot have branch protection or rulesets (the API returns 'Upgrade to
GitHub Pro'), and the public repos have none configured, so the native path would fail on every
PR and Renovate would fall back to merging itself anyway. Turn this back on per repo once a
ruleset requiring the CI check exists — which is free on the public repos.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes are the one class where a wrong bump loops or breaks production quietly. Reviewed by hand, always.

packageRules.description: Patch-level changes to anything, once CI is green.
CI actions: non-major and digest refreshes. A broken action fails loudly on the next run and never reaches production.
Dev-only npm tooling: linters, test runners, type packages.
0.x minors are breaking under semver, whatever the update type says.
Majors are always a human decision.

Nothing docker is automerged, digests included. No repo in this org builds its image on a pull_request — mojodojo and casahouse both gate build-and-push on the push/tag event — so a green PR proves nothing about a new base layer. The image only breaks after the merge, on the deploy.
